source:
## IPv4 addresses: dotted quads with RFC 5234 dec-octet bounds — each
## part is 0-255 by SHAPE, not value: single digit, 1-99, 100-199,
## 200-249, 250-255. Demonstrates layered character classes.
grammar IpAddress version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  digit = %x30-39
  ## 0-9 / 10-99 / 100-199 / 200-249 / 250-255 — longest shape first:
  ## the engine's memo does not re-invest a committed alternative into
  ## a shorter one on backtracking.
  dec_octet = ( "1" 2*digit ) / ( "2" %x30-34 digit ) / ( "25" %x30-35 ) / ( %x31-39 digit ) / digit
  dot = "."
  address = dec_octet dot dec_octet dot dec_octet dot dec_octet as octets

  entry main: address

  test {
    accept "192.168.0.1"
    accept "255.255.255.255"
    accept "0.0.0.0"
    accept "10.0.0.7"
    reject "256.1.1.1"
    reject "1.2.3"
    reject "1.2.3.4.5"
    reject "a.b.c.d"
  }
}
